area.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 specifies a 300 x 250 mm reference footprint; pages 7-10 contain conflicting procurement candidates
area.description: Executable baseline uses the V2.0 0.075 m2 footprint for all three tanks. The later BOM proposes 0.15 m2 Tank 1/Tank 2 footprints and an approximately 0.083 m2 Tank 3 footprint; field dimensions and level-volume calibration must replace this baseline before plant claims.

height_max.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 gives 400 mm reference vessel height; page 10 proposes a conflicting 442 mm Tank 3 candidate
height_max.description: Physical vessel height is kept separate from the 0-0.5 m level-transmitter span. Installed overflow and switch elevations still require field measurement.

level_sensor_range.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 specifies LT101/LT201/LT301 as 0-5 kPa or 0-0.5 m, 4-20 mA
level_sensor_range.description: Measurement span only; it is not the vessel height or allowable liquid-level limit.

cv_interstage.source_locator: Sized so a fully open DN20 valve at the V2.0 design head is of the same order as the 25 L/min circulation maximum; no valve test or installed Cv is bundled
cv_interstage.description: Provisional Torricelli coefficients for V12 and V23; replace with installed valve-position and flow-test data.

gravity_drop.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf pages 1-4 and 19 specify approximately 0.30 m, adjustable from 0.25 to 0.35 m, for both gravity drops
gravity_drop.description: Elevation head included explicitly in V12 and V23 gravity-flow equations.

overflow_level.source_locator: The PDF specifies Tank 1/Tank 2 standpipe returns to Tank 3 but gives no standpipe crest elevations
overflow_level.description: Temporary overflow onset below the 0.40 m vessel wall; replace with installed standpipe crest measurements.

cv_overflow.source_locator: No standpipe diameter, discharge test, or overflow routing loss data is bundled
cv_overflow.description: Temporary overflow coefficients set to twice the revised interstage coefficient for software safety testing only.

overflow_head_floor.source_locator: Inactive-overflow square-root derivative guard for CasADi NLP construction
overflow_head_floor.description: Used only inside the gated square root; inactive overflow remains exactly zero in both numeric and CasADi backends.

high_level_trip.source_locator: The PDF identifies high-level switches and a hardwired L3 interlock but gives no switch settings
high_level_trip.description: Temporary LSH101/LSH201/LSH301 settings. Tank 1/Tank 2 high level interlocks P101; Tank 3 high level remains an alarm input.

ua_loss.source_locator: No cooldown test or insulation specification is included in the retrofit PDF
ua_loss.description: Per-tank ambient heat-loss conductances. Separate values allow the acrylic and stainless-steel vessels to be identified later.

heater_power.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf, drawing and Tank 1/heating sections on pages 2, 4, and 7
heater_power.description: One top-inserted 2 kW immersion heater H1 on Tank 1. Tank 2 is reserved only and Tank 3 is unheated.

pump_flow_max.source: V2.0 design-sheet circulation range and pump BOM
pump_flow_max.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 gives 5-25 L/min and page 10 lists a 25 L/min maximum
pump_flow_max.description: Maximum flow at the design static head. The executable pump curve remains provisional until a VFD frequency-flow-head test is available.

pump_power_max.source: V2.0 P101 specification and pump BOM
pump_power_max.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 gives 0.25-0.37 kW and page 10 selects 0.37 kW; the separate 0.75 kW item is VFD capacity
pump_power_max.description: Provisional P101 motor rating; kept separate from 0.75 kW VFD capacity and fixed electronics load.

pump_static_head.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf pages 1, 3, and 5 identify approximately 1.7 m lift from Tank 3 to Tank 1
pump_static_head.description: Constant elevation term in the provisional P101 curve; verify against final suction and discharge elevations.

pump_shutoff_head.source: V2.0 P101 specification and pump BOM
pump_shutoff_head.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 gives 5-10 m head and page 10 lists 10 m
pump_shutoff_head.description: Used as the full-speed shutoff-head endpoint of a provisional affinity-law pump curve.

t_amb.source_locator: No laboratory ambient design condition is specified by the PDF
t_amb.description: Default ambient temperature for the lumped heat-loss model.

h_floor.description: Numerical volume floor only; it is not a residual-volume or sensor-limit claim.

low_level_trip.source_locator: The PDF specifies LSL101/LSL201/LSL301 but does not give installed switch elevations
low_level_trip.description: Temporary switches: LSL101 blocks H1 dry-fire and LSL301 blocks P101 dry-run; LSL201 remains an observable alarm input.

temperature_trip.source_locator: 三级水箱加热系统.pdf page 2 gives Tank 1 greater than 80 degC as the L4 example
temperature_trip.description: Software representation of the V2.0 example L4 trip; confirm the certified switch setting before deployment.

temperature_hard_limit.source_locator: The PDF gives no hard temperature limit and the model excludes boiling
temperature_hard_limit.description: Simulation termination boundary for an atmospheric-water abstraction, not an equipment rating.

references.title: 三级水箱系统升级布置图（阶梯式方案）及三级水箱加热系统说明
references.drawing: V2.0 design sheet plus L-001 retrofit layout
references.locator: PDF pages 1-33; page 2 is the executable V2.0 baseline
references.limitations: 非最终施工图；V2.0 总图、Updated BOM 和末尾旧采购表存在罐体尺寸、材质、阀门与流量计数量冲突；本 profile 以第 2 页 V2.0 为临时权威基线，仍需 CAD 和现场核验

validity_domain.evidence_limit: Loop topology, the 2 kW Tank 1 heater, 5-25 L/min circulation range, 0.25-0.37 kW P101 range, 0.25-0.35 m gravity drops, and physical I/O types are design-specified. Geometry conflicts with later procurement candidates; valve coefficients, installed pump curve, heat loss, actuator dynamics, and protection switch elevations remain unverified.
assumptions: closed liquid inventory with no normal product withdrawal or makeup stream
three constant-area perfectly mixed tanks with independent provisional geometry and UA
P101 transfers Tank 3 liquid and enthalpy directly to Tank 1
V12 and V23 follow one-way Torricelli flow using upstream liquid head plus the V2.0 elevation drop and no downstream backpressure
P101 follows a provisional affinity-law curve fitted to the V2.0 maximum flow, static lift, and full-speed head
instantaneous normalized valve, heater, and sensor response; actuator and sensor dynamics remain future calibration work
Tank 1 and Tank 2 passive overflows return mass and enthalpy to Tank 3 using provisional Torricelli coefficients
